. They said: ‘Verily, we have heard a wonderful Recitation

72:2.text: ‘It guides to the Right Path, and we have believed therein, and we shall never join

72:3.text: ‘And He, exalted be the Majesty of our Lord, has taken neither a wife nor a son

72:4.text: [i.e. Iblîs (Satan) or the polytheists amongst the jinn]
used to utter against Allâh that which was an enormity in falsehood.

72:5.text: ‘And verily, we thought that men and jinn would not utter a lie against Allâh.

72:6.text: ‘And verily, there were men among mankind who took shelter with the males among the jinn, but they

72:7.text: ‘And they thought as you thought, that Allâh will not send any Messenger

72:8.text: ‘And we have sought to reach the heaven; but found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.

72:9.text: ‘And verily, we used to sit there in stations, to
a hearing, but any who listens now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.

72:10.text: ‘And we know not whether evil is intended for those on earth, or whether their Lord intends for them a Right Path.

72:11.text: ‘There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary; we are groups having different ways

72:12.text: ‘And we think that we cannot escape
Allâh in the earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

, and whosoever believes in his Lord shall have no fear, either of a decrease in the reward of his good deeds or an increase in the punishment for his sins.
